description: List sync health for every cost/event/usage connection this account has — last synced time, next scheduled sync, the outcome of its most recent run, and `is_overdue` (no successful sync within twice the connection's own effective sync interval). `recent_failure_count` counts failed runs among the last 5, and a run that finished but reported a partial failure (`latest_run.partial_failure`, with the reason in `latest_run.error`) counts as failed. `status` flips to `error` when a sync job throws, but not for a partial failure or between a failure and the next success, so `is_overdue` and `recent_failure_count` — not `status` — are the real signals that a connection has gone stale or is failing. Check this before asserting that recent cost or usage data is complete, especially right before calling query_costs or query_usage for a very recent date range. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/data-health.
name: list_data_health
